note: Every number the estimate takes from a paper, with its reference. Transcribed 2026-09-30.

rsa2048.label: RSA-2048 (Gidney 2025)
rsa2048.cite: Gidney, How to factor 2048 bit RSA integers with less than a million noisy qubits, arXiv:2505.15917: 1,409 logical qubits at most (Table 4: m = 1,280 in cold storage, the rest hot); 6.5e9 Toffolis (Table 5, n = 2048); 897,864 physical qubits and 12.07 hours per shot (cost section).

femoco_reiher.label: FeMoco, Reiher Hamiltonian (Lee et al. 2021)
femoco_reiher.cite: Lee et al., Even more efficient quantum computations of chemistry through tensor hypercontraction, PRX Quantum 2, 030305, arXiv:2011.03494: Table III (THC, 2,142 logical qubits, 5.3e9 Toffolis); Fig. 10 and p. 31 (1,908 patches at d = 31, about four million qubits, 3 days).

femoco_li.label: FeMoco, Li Hamiltonian (Lee et al. 2021)
femoco_li.cite: Lee et al. 2021, Table III (THC, 2,196 logical qubits, 3.2e10 Toffolis).

litinski_factories_cite: Litinski, Magic state distillation: not as costly as you think, Quantum 3, 205 (2019), arXiv:1905.06903, Table 1 (p. 2). Qubits include measurement ancillas; qubitcycles are per output state.

cultivation.cite: Gidney 2025 (arXiv:2505.15917), magic-state section: T states cultivated to 1e-7 for 30,000 qubit·rounds at p = 1e-3 (Gidney, Shutty and Jones, arXiv:2409.17595); 8T-to-CCZ with error 28 p_T²; a factory of 3 × 4 hot patches making one CCZ per 150 rounds at d = 25.

yoked.cite: Gidney 2025: cold storage in yoked surface codes, 430 physical qubits per logical qubit at 1e-15 per round (p = 1e-3).

blocks.cite: Litinski, A Game of Surface Codes, Quantum 3, 128 (2019), arXiv:1808.02892, Sec. 2 (pp. 7-9): tiles for n data qubits and time steps (of d cycles) to consume a magic state; a tile is 2d² physical qubits, as his examples count them (226 tiles at d = 13: 76,400 qubits).

gross_module.cite: Bravyi et al. 2024 (the gross code, 288 qubits for 12 logical); Cross et al. 2024, arXiv:2407.18393 (103 ancilla qubits to measure its logical operators).
